title: Giotto object manifest
description: Machine-readable inventory of a giotto object, emitted by GiottoClass::objManifest_json(). Derived from the object on demand, never stored on it. Companion document: history.ndjson, one operation per line, from objHistory_ndjson().

generated_by.description: Package and version that wrote this document.

uid.description: Minted once at object creation and carried through renames, copies and save/load. Null for objects created before uids existed.

source.description: Class of the object's backing source. Null when the object is held in memory.

versions.description: Contents of the object's versions slot, as strings.

summary.description: Read first. Everything under slots is the detail this indexes.

slots.description: One entry per non-empty giotto slot, holding one record per subobject in that slot. `view` and `spaces` hold one record per recipe, keyed by its name. A record carries the keys that retrieve it under `keys`. Records are sorted by those keys, so the document is canonical and diffs are stable.

warnings.description: Fields that could not be READ (an accessor errored), as the record's identity (slot then its key values, dot-joined) followed by the field name. A field that reads cleanly and is simply absent is omitted rather than listed here.

leaf.description: One subobject, or for cell_ID / feat_ID one id set. Carries its keys, its form (class, dtype, method) and its content fingerprint; sizes and extents are not reported, since they cost a scan on disk-backed payloads. Fields beyond the keys and class are class-specific and are omitted when not applicable.

keys.description: The record's identity, and nothing else: the accessor arguments that retrieve it, in this order, and only the ones that apply. Pass them to the slot's getter as named arguments.

columns.description: For metadata, one entry per column keyed by the column name; for spatial locations, enrichment and dim reductions, the column names (a dim reduction's are its components).

n_levels.description: Distinct values in the column. Only with objManifest(levels = TRUE), and never for the id column.

fingerprint.description: Hash of the whole column; lets a diff name the column an edit touched.

compact.description: giottoBinPoints: whether the counts table is in its compacted form.

n_steps.description: view / spaces: number of recorded steps.

step_types.description: view / spaces: distinct step types, in first-recorded order (filter, crop, samples, transform).

fingerprint.description: Hash identifying the record's content, from GiottoClass::fingerprint_data(). In-memory content (matrices, tables, graphs, recipe steps) is hashed in full and exactly; geometry is a fixed-stride sample compared to 12 significant digits as an ordered vertex multiset; images are identified by their source files; disk-backed payloads by their handle. Deterministic and RNG-free. Opaque: compare for equality only. Absent when fingerprinting was not requested or the payload has no fingerprint method, in which case the field is listed in warnings.

x-encoding-rules.special-values: NA, NaN, Inf and -Inf are encoded as the strings "NA", "NaN", "Inf" and "-Inf", never as JSON null. A JSON null means the field was absent, which is a different fact.
x-encoding-rules.key-order: Object keys are emitted in sorted order at every level so two manifests of the same state serialize identically.

x-alabaster-alignment.intent: Slot vocabulary is close enough to takane/alabaster that a GiottoDisk<->alabaster bridge and cross-language readers should be cheap to add later. expression maps to assays, cell_metadata to column_data, feat_metadata to row_data, dimension_reduction to reduced_dimensions, spatial_locs to the spatial coordinates of a SpatialExperiment. The Giotto-specific spat_unit x feat_type nesting has no takane equivalent and would become one takane object per (spat_unit, feat_type) pair.
